newsitem.title: USA: Novatek amends qtly reports, adds write-offs.
newsitem.headline: Novatek amends qtly reports, adds write-offs.

text.p: Novatek International Inc said Friday it has filed to amend its quarterly reports for the periods ending March 31 and June 30 this year to correct the accounting in its merger with Medical Products Inc.
Novatek said the amendments will include a write-off of goodwill recorded for its construction business because its management will likely dispose of the business.
The write-off could be as high as $30 million, the company said.

Novatek said blamed the mistake on the complexity of the merger. It said Medical Products should have been classified as the acquiring company in the deal because its stockholders received more of the common interests and voting rights.
To make the change, Medical Products will record Novatek assets and liabilities at their fair values as of March 5, 1996, Novatek said.
Novatek said its September 30 report should reflect the corrected accounting. It said its corrected quarterly reports and its September 30 report should be available by November 14.
